In case of reverse deputation, the employer's share of Contributory Provident Fund for the period on deputation has to be borne either by the employee himself or the Central Government depending on the terms of deputation. A clear mention of above stipulation has to be made in the terms of deputation. - GIO (1), Section I, Appendix 5.
